get.description: Returns two Articles per page. Search matches titles only. Unknown or duplicate query parameters are rejected. The raw query is limited to 4096 bytes.

parameters.description: Title substring, at most 64 UTF-8 bytes. An empty value is accepted. Duplicate values are rejected.
parameters.name: search

parameters.description: Exact lowercase true or false. Omission includes both values; empty or duplicate values are rejected.
parameters.name: published

parameters.description: Order by id ascending or descending. Omission orders by id ascending; duplicate values are rejected.
parameters.name: ordering

parameters.description: Positive decimal page number. Omission or an empty value selects page 1. Two results per page. Invalid, overflowing, or out-of-range pages return 404; duplicate values return 400.
parameters.name: page

200.description: A page of Articles, with relative next and previous links or null.
